chunks: And from him (Al-Husayn ibn Idris) he said: My father narrated to me, saying: Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Fadhal narrated to me, saying: Amr ibn Ibrahim narrated to us from Khalaf ibn Hammad from Abdullah ibn Hassan from Al-Thumali from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) in a hadith that he narrated:

That it was in the will of the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him): 'Take me out to the open area (Zahr), and when your feet are firmly planted and a wind faces you, bury me, for it is the first peak of Sinai.' So they did that.

key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (title for Imam Ali)
key_terms.الظَّهْرِ: The open area or elevated ground (referring to a specific location in Kufa)
key_terms.طُورِ سَيْنَاءَ: Mount Sinai (used here to identify the specific location's characteristics)

ai.seo_question: What were the specific burial instructions given by Imam Ali in his will?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the specific burial instructions of Imam Ali (AS), linking his resting place to the 'first peak of Sinai' (Awal Tur Sinai), a site traditionally identified with the area near the Great Mosque in Kufa. The detail regarding the wind and firm ground underscores the divine providence in selecting a location that would remain distinct and accessible for veneration, reinforcing the scholarly emphasis on the sanctity of Kufa as a primary center of Shia piety.
